messages:
Sam Rivera: Evelyn from FinBank asked for an ISO/ISMS applicability statement for the upcoming POC. They want explicit control ownership mapping (Redwood vs FinBank), CAIQ export, pen-test summary, and confirmation that model cache/backups are encrypted. Can we get a minimal pack by Wed?
Priya Nair: We can. Quick clarifications: is this for Dedicated reserved capacity or Private VPC? Ownership differs slightly. Also confirm that the POC will not use live customer PII.
Evelyn (FinBank): POC will run in their VPC with customer-managed KMS. It's Private deployment. They will use synthetic data only. Timeline: need docs by Wed EOD to pass to vendor risk.
Tom Hsu: For Private (customer VPC) deploys we operate the inference runtime and service processes; customer retains network & host OS control. Encryption at rest for model cache/backups is performed by the runtime using wrapped keys via customer KMS when configured. We don't hold raw customer keys.
Priya Nair: Draft applicability (short):
```
Applicability statement (Redwood Inference Private POC):
Scope: Redwood-managed inference runtime, model serving components, runtime patching, vulnerability scanning, authentication/authorization controls within the Redwood service boundary.
Out-of-scope: customer-managed VPC networking, host OS, physical access, and customer-owned data stores.
Control ownership: Redwood: runtime patching, runtime vulnerability scanning, access controls for Redwood console/service accounts, telemetry (redacted), incident response for the service. Customer: VPC configs, host OS patching (on-prem), KMS key lifecycle and access, data classification and DLP.

This statement does not assert certification of customer-managed components.
```
Sam Rivera: Perfect. Can we also produce: CAIQ export, redacted pen test exec summary, encryption policy extract, and a simple control matrix mapping to ISO Annex A (high-level)?
SecurityBot: CAIQ_export_2026-03-20.pdf uploaded to /shared/compliance/finbank/1769952105  https://redwood-internal/share/CAIQ_export_1769952105.pdf
Tom Hsu: I'll produce the infra diagram + control matrix. Pen-test summary is redacted but we can share exec findings and date of most recent test. Encryption policy excerpt attached as a doc.
Priya Nair: Note for legal: include the signed applicability statement PDF with a short cover note clarifying 'no live PII' for the POC and that customer-managed infra is out-of-scope. Also add our vulnerability scanning cadence (weekly scans + quarterly full scans) and patch SLA (critical within 72 hours for runtime components).
Evelyn (FinBank): That should satisfy our vendor team. Can you confirm you will not collect customer keys or backups outside of the customer's KMS?
Tom Hsu: Confirmed: keys remain in customer-managed KMS. Backups of model-cache may be encrypted with keys wrapped by customer KMS; we will not export unencrypted backups.
Sam Rivera: Plan: Priya to assemble applicability and cover note by Tue noon, Tom to upload diagrams and control matrix by Tue EOD, SecurityBot/ops to push CAIQ and pen-test summary to secure share. I'll send to FinBank once uploaded.
Priya Nair: Will add a one-page signed applicability PDF and a short email template. Will mark items that require legal review.
Sam Rivera: Thanks everyone  I'll follow up on the kickoff slot after FinBank confirms.
